draft.title: Moon trine Lilith
draft.humanMoment: At a family reunion, the planned buffet sits untouched while relatives crowd around a cousin frying a dish the hosts had ruled too messy for the rented hall.
draft.developmentDetail: Second helpings disappear quickly as grease spots spread across the tablecloth and the usual small talk gives way to loud requests for the recipe.
draft.planetaryDynamic: The Moon supplies the comfort of a shared family meal, while Lilith brings forward the appetite that the hosts tried to keep off the menu.
draft.aspectMechanic: Under the trine, the reunion's familiar comfort and the ruled-out frying reinforce each other, so the crowd keeps asking for more before anyone questions the mess.
draft.conditionalConsequence: If the forbidden dish becomes the center of the reunion, the hosts may face a cleaning charge after an evening everyone else remembers as the first one that felt satisfying.

judge.weakest: Under the trine, the reunion's familiar comfort and the ruled-out frying reinforce each other, so the crowd keeps asking for more before anyone questions the mess.
judge.why: The phrasing "ruled-out frying" is slightly compressed, but the sentence clearly shows ease allowing comfort and forbidden appetite to reinforce each other while consequences go unchallenged.
